continuity_scope: Bandai Namco Entertainment Europe English Tales of Arise base-game promotional/character witness, for the 10 September 2021 PS4/PS5/Xbox One/Xbox Series X|S/PC release. The November 2023 Beyond the Dawn expansion, its Nazamil story, all costume/item/crossover DLC, later patches, and the rest of the Tales anthology are separate continuities/states.
work_or_witnesses: Bandai Namco Entertainment Europe, Tales of Arise official page
Bandai Namco Entertainment Europe, Meet Dohalim and Kisara… news, 10 June 2021
Bandai Namco Entertainment Europe, Tales of Arise release news, 22 April 2021
coverage_rule: All individually named playable figures with direct named prose profiles or a named official release-profile paragraph in the selected base-game materials: Alphen, Shionne, Rinwell, Law, Kisara, and Dohalim. Hootle is named but explicitly a pet owl; the Mysterious Swordsman is not named. Nazamil, Beyond the Dawn-only story states, and DLC/crossover visitors are excluded.
omissions: Hootle, the unnamed Mysterious Swordsman, unnamed Renan Lords/resistance figures, all non-profiled base-game characters, and all generic peoples/factions/creatures/items/mechanics as nodes.
Beyond the Dawn/Nazamil, costume/item/crossover DLC, later Switch 2 edition behavior, patches, and every other Tales title/adaptation.
Player party/control, combo/build choices, quest states, romance interpretations, endings, and any outcome beyond the official base-game promotional witness.
uncertainties: The official site is a curated early/base-game promotional roster, not a script or complete codex; pass-complete applies strictly to six named playable profiles.
Some base-page character text is promotional and the Mysterious Swordsman remains unnamed; no identity inference is made.
Official materials promote combinations and party systems; these do not make player-selected builds or optional outcomes canonical character facts.
evidence_basis: Bandai Namco first-party English base-game website and dated news only. No fan source is used as canonical evidence.
